title: Flash flood greets flood of party delegates | The Star
text:
Flash flood greets flood of party delegates | The Star
KUALA LUMPUR: The Umno wing meetings at the World Trade Centre here were temporarily halted after flash floods hit the open-air car park yesterday.
Delegates who parked at the parking lot next to the Klang-Gombak river were seen rushing to their vehicles after warning sirens and an announcement blared over the speakers repeatedly.
